summary.one_liner: A browsable catalogue of 203 named design patterns for building AI agents, each readable as Markdown, grouped by category and maturity status.
keywords: what patterns exist for building ai agents
takeaways: Browse 203 AI agent design patterns, each with a short description, category, and maturity status such as proposed, emerging, established, or validated in production
Find patterns across categories including context and memory, orchestration and control, tool use, reliability and eval, security and safety, and UX and collaboration
Read any pattern as a plain Markdown file, or fetch it as .md to give to your own coding agent
Use the status labels to judge how proven a pattern is before adopting it
summary.summary: This is a web catalogue of 203 design patterns for building AI agents, presented as a filterable list. Each entry has a title, a one-line description of the approach, a category (such as Context & Memory, Orchestration & Control, Security & Safety, or Tool Use & Environment), and a maturity label like proposed, emerging, established, or validated in production. Individual patterns are published as plain Markdown files that can be read in the browser or downloaded for use by an agent. The visible page text is an index listing only; it does not include the full pattern write-ups, so depth per pattern is not shown here.
